items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: But we think that Clinton’s escapades were grotesque really.

ctx.x: In a broader sense I’m interested in what Britain thinks of the United States as a whole? How do they look at our last November’s mess with the election?

Well I think we think that was laughable. It got a lot of space. But we think that Clinton’s escapades were grotesque really. So you know, I don’t think the great British public would have too strong an opinion either way. They’d say they’re all a bunch of rogues and vagabonds. They don’t feel much different about our own politicians to be honest. So I don’t think that did America any favors, let’s put it that way. But the extent of American influence is very considerable.
